summary: Master Production Planning and Control with MPS, MRP, capacity planning, and shop-floor control. Build practical skills for manufacturing delivery. Register tod
lede: Production planning and control courses help manufacturing professionals turn demand into workable schedules by coordinating capacity, materials and shop-floor execution. They cover building a master production schedule, checking capacity gaps and material requirements, sequencing and releasing orders, and tracking schedule adherence and production status to identify bottlenecks and respond to disruptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with manufacturing plans, orders, materials, or schedules and need a more structured approach to control. It suits people who influence daily production decisions and report on delivery, capacity, and execution performance.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for spreadsheet exercises and planning templates. If your organization uses ERP or MES reports, you may optionally bring sample output for comparison during exercises.
